selection: Each campaign independently selects maximal shared MPKI with >=15% shared utilization and its predeclared validity gates
interpretation: A gain at 10% establishes a separate normal-sampling operating-point result. Differences in gain versus the 100% campaign cannot be attributed solely to sampling because arrival rate differs. A failure at10% likewise does not prove dependence on 100% tracing.
warmup: The original100% 300RPS point remains excluded under its then-current gate. New10% trials use the predeclared 50s warmup/zero steady-error gate; no old point is retrospectively reclassified.
